reason: Confirmed from the cited source and one independent source, both opened. The SCTDA press release (sharjahtourism.ae, dateline April 30, 2025) states verbatim: "Sharjah attracted approximately 1.6 million hotel guests in 2024, reflecting an 11% increase compared to 2023"; "Russian guests ranked first with over 270,000 guests, representing an 18% increase"; Indian guests second with over 170,000 (+6%); European guests over 100,000 (+16%); "Chinese guests surged to over 60,000 guests, an exceptional increase of 828%"; and "Oman topped the list ... accounting for 6% of total guests in 2024, followed by Saudi Arabia at 5%, Egypt at 4%, and Syria and Iraq at 3% each." Gulf Today (gulftoday.ae/business/2025/04/30/sctda-reveals-sharjah-received-around-16m-hotel-guests-in-2024, last updated April 30, 2025) reproduces the same sentences and figures and attributes them to the SCTDA. Web search results from Arabian Business and Zawya carry the same numbers. The WAM page returned no article body, so it was not used. Every number, name, ranking, and the 30 April 2025 date in the claim match the sources. Two non-errors worth noting: the claim omits Europe's growth rate (16%), and Oman's 6% is a share of total guests rather than a count, which the claim's wording ("led Arab markets at 6%") already implies.
